main.description: Something you'd like done, for friends to take on with their own agents. Public seeds live in your repo and `audience` says who it's meant for (a filter apps respect, not access control). Private ones live in your repo inside a group's Rainshare space, readable only by its members.

spec.description: What you want, in Markdown: the problem, what done looks like, and anything to avoid. It is shown to the helper's agent as a request from you, not as instructions it must follow.

specUrl.description: A longer spec elsewhere, such as a SPEC.md in the repo.

values.description: What the project stands for, so values-aligned helpers can find it.

audience.description: Who this is meant for. #following: people you follow. #followers: people who follow you. #mutuals: both. #group: the members of the group whose space it's in.

stage.description: How far along the project is, for one that has a repo: a seedling (just started), a young plant (it works, still taking shape) or an established one (people rely on it). With no repo it's a seed: an idea.

owner.description: For an idea with no repo yet, who keeps what gets built: the helper (run with it, it's yours) or the requester (start it for me).

parallel.description: More than one helper is welcome to try at once.

tangledIssue.description: A Tangled issue: its record when it was picked from the repo's issues, its page when it was pasted as a link, or both. Apps write at least one of uri and url.

uri.description: The issue's org.tangled.track.ticket record, in the repo's own account.

repoUrl.description: The repo's page, which git can clone from.

knotlessIssue.description: An issue on knotless: its page, the repo's page (which git can clone from), and its record.

repoUrl.description: The repo's page, which git can clone from.

uri.description: The issue's dev.knotless.issue record, in its author's account.

url.description: Where to clone it from, or its page.

repoDid.description: For a Tangled repo, its DID.

families.description: The model families you'd prefer, most wanted first. Left out, any model.

level.description: How capable a model you'd prefer. frontier: the most capable model a family has. Left out, any level.

models.description: Specific models you'd like used, most wanted first. What older asks said: apps now ask for families and a level.

mutuals.description: People you follow who follow you back.

followers.description: People who follow you on Bluesky.

list.description: An app.bsky.graph.list of people you trust.

group.description: The group whose space holds this seed.
